mapper.select: SELECT id, name, region, description, cover_url, sort_order, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM buildings WHERE is_deleted =0 AND status =1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, region, description, cover_url, sort_order, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM buildings WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted =0
